releaseNotes:
• Dynamic Island Progress HUD Pill: Sleek top floating HUD providing real-time visual progress (link detected, resolving, downloading, saved) across all apps without focus theft
• Smart Differential Re-Download: Interactive Bottom Sheet inspecting MediaStore and IS_TRASHED to detect missing/corrupted files with 1-tap restore
• Sub-300ms Thumbnail Grid: Extracts low-res GraphQL thumbnail resources (~320px, ~25KB) with Semaphore(4) concurrency and in-flight deduplication
• Modern Material 3 Settings UI: Hero storage card with dynamic breakdown, live Accessibility watchdog telemetry with OEM quick-fix actions, and categorized cards
• Native Lossless Reel Audio Extractor: Zero-bloat demuxing of background music (.m4a) via native MediaExtractor + MediaMuxer into Music/InstaSave/ with 0 KB APK bloat
